traits.leaf_width_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Calamagrostis nutkaensis: blades 8 mm to 1.2 cm wide.

traits.culm_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Calamagrostis nutkaensis: culms 1 m to 1.5 m tall.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Calamagrostis nutkaensis: panicle 15 cm to 30 cm long.

appearance.organs.panicle.note: The panicle's layout, the model's choice after FNA (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page was not read): a contracted to somewhat loose panicle, its spikelets on the outer half of its branches. Drawn as 20 branches in pairs, close to the axis, each with about 20 spikelets on short stalks on its outer half. Colours by eye: purplish.

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): panicles (8)12 to 23(33) cm, contracted to somewhat loose, erect to slightly nodding, the spikelets on the branches' outer half; spikelets 4.5 to 6.5(8) mm; lemmas (3)4 to 4.5(5) mm, a little shorter than the glumes; awns 1 to 3 mm, attached on the lower third to half of the lemma, not sticking out of the spikelet.

traits.florets_per_spikelet.note: The Jepson eFlora's account of the genus, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): one floret, the axis prolonged beyond it and hairy.

traits.upper_glume_length_m.note: The Jepson eFlora's account of the species, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): glumes 5 to 7(7.5) mm, smooth to rough on the keel.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a large, dense tussock of long, coarse, arching blades with tall, narrow, purplish panicles. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.3 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green blades; purplish then tan panicles.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
